title: 1.1 Definition and Nature of Physics
description: Definition and Nature of Physics concepts and applications. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which statement captures the aim of physics as a natural science?
options: It describes the basic mechanisms that make the universe behave as it does
It classifies living organisms into named groups in physics in experiments
It studies the composition and reactions of matter only now in experiments
It records the political history of nations in the textbook in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: It describes the basic mechanisms that make the universe behave as it does

questions.question: A builder checks why a wall stays standing for centuries. Which branch of physics is most directly relevant?
options: Mechanics
Acoustics
Nuclear physics
Optics
questions.correctAnswer: Mechanics

questions.question: Which example shows physics being used to improve medical diagnosis?
options: Developing imaging techniques for the body
Writing new laws for hospitals in the unit
Designing hospital uniforms in experiments
Training nurses in record keeping in class
questions.correctAnswer: Developing imaging techniques for the body

questions.question: Which pair of fields both rely on physics according to the textbook?
options: Engineering and medicine
Poetry and painting here
History and law in class
Music and dance in class
questions.correctAnswer: Engineering and medicine

questions.question: A student says physics only studies distant stars. Which fact from the textbook broadens this view?
options: Physics explains familiar devices and daily phenomena
Physics is older than all other subjects for students
Physics uses only advanced mathematics in experiments
Physics has no practical applications in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Physics explains familiar devices and daily phenomena

questions.question: Which reason explains why physics supports technological innovation?
options: It reveals principles that new devices can use
It supplies the money for factories in physics
It writes the laws that factories obey as well
It trains workers to use tools in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: It reveals principles that new devices can use

questions.question: Which statement about a physicist is accurate?
options: A physicist investigates concepts, laws and relationships of nature
A physicist only repairs electrical appliances here in the textbook
A physicist studies the naming of animals in physics in experiments
A physicist designs school timetables in this topic in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: A physicist investigates concepts, laws and relationships of nature

questions.question: Which phenomenon would a physicist investigate rather than a biologist?
options: The motion of a falling object
The growth of a plant in class
The digestion of food in class
The inheritance of traits here
questions.correctAnswer: The motion of a falling object

questions.question: Which field uses physics to understand how buildings handle heating and lighting?
options: Engineering
Pharmacy
Agriculture
Theology
questions.correctAnswer: Engineering

questions.question: Which contribution of physics is most relevant to transportation?
options: Understanding the working principles of vehicles
Classifying the species of transport animals now
Writing traffic regulations here in the textbook
Painting road signs for students in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Understanding the working principles of vehicles

questions.question: Why are physics principles important for heritage buildings?
options: They explain how structures keep their balance
They determine the artistic value of the buildings
They record the names of the builders
They describe the climate of the region
questions.correctAnswer: They explain how structures keep their balance

questions.question: Which statement about physics and other sciences is best supported by the text?
options: Physics supplies foundational ideas used across many sciences
Physics replaces all other sciences in physics in experiments
Physics is unrelated to modern technology now in the textbook
Physics depends only on observation without experiments still
questions.correctAnswer: Physics supplies foundational ideas used across many sciences

questions.question: Which example belongs to meteorology as an application of physics?
options: Studying atmospheric motion and weather
Studying the structure of atomic nuclei
Studying the behavior of light in lenses
Studying the fossils of ancient life
questions.correctAnswer: Studying atmospheric motion and weather

questions.question: Which activity would a metrologist carry out?
options: Maintaining reliable standards of measurement
Diagnosing patients with scanners in the unit
Classifying rocks by age here in the textbook
Designing musical instruments in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Maintaining reliable standards of measurement

questions.question: Which set contains only areas where physics is applied?
options: Transport, medicine and space science
Farming, cooking and storytelling now
Painting, poetry and dance in physics
History, law and religion in the unit
questions.correctAnswer: Transport, medicine and space science

questions.question: What role does experimentation play in physics?
options: It tests ideas against observed behavior
It replaces the need for careful thought
It records opinions of experts
It removes the need for measurement
questions.correctAnswer: It tests ideas against observed behavior

questions.question: Which phenomenon is explained using the principles of physics rather than biology?
options: The difficulty of walking on a smooth surface
The germination of a seed now in the textbook
The flowering of a plant here in the textbook
The spread of a disease still in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: The difficulty of walking on a smooth surface

questions.question: Which of these best describes the scope of physics?
options: From everyday devices to the behavior of the universe
Only the study of very small particles in experiments
Only the study of planets and stars now in this topic
Only the design of machines in physics in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: From everyday devices to the behavior of the universe

questions.question: A school introduces a new curriculum in physics. Which aim matches the textbooks description?
options: To help learners understand concepts and laws of nature
To train learners only for factory work in the textbook
To memorize the names of all scientists in the textbook
To avoid any practical activities still in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: To help learners understand concepts and laws of nature

questions.question: Which fact about physics is emphasized by the Greek origin of its name?
options: It is concerned with nature
It was invented in the twentieth century
It deals only with numbers
It is a branch of social science
questions.correctAnswer: It is concerned with nature
